# Orleans.Lattice

> Orleans.Lattice is a platform for building durable, distributed state systems on Microsoft Orleans. At its centre is a sorted, horizontally-scalable, conflict-free key-value store that runs inside your own cluster. Around it are the concerns a real system acquires once it outgrows one machine - storage, identity, governance, replication, administration, observability - each implemented as a companion package behind a seam in the core, rather than baked into it.

This file is the repository's entry point for AI agents and LLM tooling. The complete documentation index is published with the documentation site, generated from the same catalogue as the site's documentation map, so it lists every package and every page of the newest release and cannot drift from them. This file deliberately does not repeat it.

Every page on the site also has a markdown alternate at the same address ending in `.md`, announced by `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` and by a note under the page's title. Every page names the release it documents, in its footer and in that note, and a package's pages also name the version of the package they describe. In this repository the documentation is markdown under `docs/`, and every public type carries XML doc comments that ship in the NuGet packages. Prefer the linked markdown over crawling source.

## Documentation index

- [llms.txt](https://nsta1.github.io/Orleans.Lattice/llms.txt): Every page of the documentation site, grouped by the seam each package fills, each linked to its markdown, with the three reading paths (Build, Evaluate, Operate).
- [llms-full.txt](https://nsta1.github.io/Orleans.Lattice/llms-full.txt): Every documentation page's markdown in one file. Each package's documentation is also in one file of its own, `docs/<package>/llms-full.txt` on the site, which the index lists with the package.
- [sitemap.xml](https://nsta1.github.io/Orleans.Lattice/sitemap.xml): Every rendered page of the site.

## Operating Orleans.Lattice

- [docs/agents/index.json](docs/agents/index.json): The machine-readable specifications for agents operating an Orleans.Lattice deployment - operational invariants, capability envelopes with guarantees and non-guarantees, procedures with preconditions, postconditions, failure modes and rollback, per-operation API contracts with error taxonomy, retry, idempotency and concurrency, governance decision trees, and the JSON Schemas that define every file's format. They describe every surface Lattice ships; a given host exposes only the packages it registers, so read each surface's `availability` before relying on it. The published copies are listed under Agent specifications in the site's llms.txt.

- [MCP tool contracts](docs/agents/api/mcp.json): Registered tool names, parameters, availability and capability gates. Confirm the actual host's tools/list before calling.
- [Region backfill](docs/agents/procedures/region-backfill.yaml): New-region bootstrap with or without tenancy; automatic verified tenant promotion and progress.
- [Tenant region drain](docs/agents/procedures/tenant-region-drain.yaml): Withdraw tenant residency and revoke an allowed region after automatic drain.
- [Replication re-seed](docs/agents/procedures/replication-reseed.yaml): Shadow-copy bootstrap, legacy fenced recovery, source lineage and incremental handoff.
- [Peer management](docs/agents/procedures/replication-peer-management.yaml): Reversible detach versus permanent decommission.

User-facing pages declare `agent_spec` in YAML front matter. Their published Markdown alternates retain its absolute URL and HTML announces it through `rel="describedby"`. Generated or unannotated pages fall back to the agent manifest.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): What the platform is, why it exists, the Local/Team/Global deployment journey, the seam-oriented architecture, and quick start.
- [Features](FEATURES.md): The complete capability catalogue, grouped by concern, each row linking its docs and a runnable sample where one exists.
- [Packages](PACKAGES.md): The complete package inventory, grouped by the seam each package fills, each row linking its documentation.

## Working on this repository

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Build/test commands, conventions, and hygiene gates for agents making changes here.
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): Repository conventions.
- [docs-site/stage.ps1](docs-site/stage.ps1): Builds the documentation site from this repository, including its llms.txt. `pwsh docs-site/build.ps1` writes the index for the checked-out branch to `docs-site/_site/llms.txt`.
